headline.purpose: Inspector section title, HUD readout values, loading and empty-stage headlines.

title.purpose: Section headings inside the inspector; brand name.

body-sm.purpose: Control text: inputs, buttons, tiles, status pills, breadcrumb, notices.

label.purpose: Field labels, notes, key-value keys, artboard label. Sentence case.

rail-label.purpose: Text under rail icons and HUD captions only.

readout.purpose: Changing numeric values on the stage HUD; tabular.

data.purpose: Run IDs, saved paths, code and pre blocks.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Lift for primary and danger buttons and the active segment.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: Floating toolbar in Garage and while driving.

shadows.name: shadow-artboard
shadows.purpose: Camera stage, drive viewport and recording player.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Field focus halo, paired with an accent border.

shadows.name: option-active
shadows.purpose: Active option tile: doubles the accent border.

motion.name: state-quick
motion.purpose: Hover and border/background state changes on controls, rail items and tiles.

motion.name: switch
motion.purpose: Switch knob travel; 160ms ease for track colour and sheet backdrop.

motion.name: disclosure
motion.purpose: Details chevron rotation and artboard selection outline and handles.

motion.name: panel-in
motion.purpose: Inspector panel enters with a 4px rise and fade.

motion.name: sheet-in
motion.purpose: Mobile bottom sheet enters with a 24px rise and fade.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses all animations and transitions.

breakpoints.name: sheet
breakpoints.purpose: Rail and inspector merge into a bottom sheet; canvas full width.

breakpoints.name: touch
breakpoints.purpose: 40px controls, thumb keys, toolbar above keys.

breakpoints.name: inspector-container
breakpoints.purpose: Field grids collapse 3 to 2 to 1; recordings library stacks.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a surface, e.g. Start session.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7.5 5.5v13l11-6.5z"/></svg>Start session</button>
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:30px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease,border-color 120ms ease,color 120ms ease;} .ds-btn-primary{background:var(--accent, #2f5bea);color:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm, 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,18,.08));} .ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-hover, #2149d4);} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #2f5bea);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White button on a strong hairline for secondary actions such as Stop & Save.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-secondary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 7h10v10H7z"/></svg>Stop & Save</button>
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:30px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease,border-color 120ms ease,color 120ms ease;} .ds-btn-secondary{border-color:var(--line-strong, #cfcfcb);background:var(--panel, #fff);color:var(--text, #1b1b1a);} .ds-btn-secondary:hover{background:var(--panel-2, #f4f4f2);} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #2f5bea);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent tertiary action; fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:30px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease,border-color 120ms ease,color 120ms ease;} .ds-btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--text-2, #5f5f5b);} .ds-btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--panel-2, #f4f4f2);color:var(--text, #1b1b1a);} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #2f5bea);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive or safety-critical action, e.g. Emergency Brake.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-danger"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8.3 3.5h7.4l4.8 4.8v7.4l-4.8 4.8H8.3l-4.8-4.8V8.3zM8 12h8"/></svg>Emergency Brake</button>
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:30px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease,border-color 120ms ease,color 120ms ease;} .ds-btn-danger{background:var(--bad, #c0362e);color:#fff;font-weight:600;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm, 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,18,.08));} .ds-btn-danger:hover{background:var(--bad-ink, #a62c25);} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #2f5bea);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Field
components.description: Label over a borderless filled control; focus lifts to white with an accent halo.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:5px;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;} .ds-field span{color:var(--text-2, #5f5f5b);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;} .ds-field input{height:30px;padding:0 9px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;background:var(--panel-2, #f4f4f2);color:var(--text, #1b1b1a);font:inherit;font-size:12.5px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;transition:border-color 120ms ease,box-shadow 120ms ease,background-color 120ms ease;} .ds-field input:hover{border-color:var(--line-strong, #cfcfcb);} .ds-field input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--accent, #2f5bea);outline:0;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-ring, rgba(47,91,234,.28));background:var(--panel, #fff);}

components.name: Section Rail
components.description: Left icon rail of inspector sections; active item on the accent wash.
components.html: <nav class="ds-rail"><button><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 19 9 9l4 6 3-4 5 8H3ZM16 6.5a1.5 1.5 0 1 0 0-.01"/></svg>Scene</button><button class="active" aria-selected="true"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 16v-3.5L6 7.8A2 2 0 0 1 7.8 6.5h8.4a2 2 0 0 1 1.8 1.3l2 4.7V16M3.5 16h17v2.5h-17zM6.5 18.5V20M17.5 18.5V20M4.5 12.5h15M7.5 14.3h.01M16.5 14.3h.01"/></svg>Vehicle</button><button><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.5 12S6 5.5 12 5.5 21.5 12 21.5 12 18 18.5 12 18.5 2.5 12 2.5 12ZM12 15a3 3 0 1 0 0-6 3 3 0 0 0 0 6Z"/></svg>Vision</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-rail{display:grid;gap:2px;width:72px;padding:8px 6px;border-right:1px solid var(--line, #e2e2df);background:var(--panel, #fff);font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;} .ds-rail button{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:4px;padding:8px 2px 7px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-2, #5f5f5b);font:inherit;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.1;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease,color 120ms ease;} .ds-rail button:hover{background:var(--panel-2, #f4f4f2);color:var(--text, #1b1b1a);} .ds-rail button.active{background:var(--accent-soft, #e8edfd);color:var(--accent-ink, #1f45c9);} .ds-rail button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #2f5bea);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Camera presets and cockpit views; the active segment lifts to white.
components.css: .ds-seg{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;padding:2px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--panel-2, #f4f4f2);font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;} .ds-seg button{min-height:26px;padding:0 9px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-2, #5f5f5b);font:inherit;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;} .ds-seg button:hover{color:var(--text, #1b1b1a);} .ds-seg button.active{background:var(--panel, #fff);color:var(--text, #1b1b1a);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm, 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,18,.08));} .ds-seg button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #2f5bea);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Status Pills
components.description: State dots whose shape carries the state: solid ok, ring offline, half pending, struck off, pulse running.
components.html: CARLA onlineCARLA offlineBridge busy · retryingBridge not configuredDriving
components.css: .ds-status{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;} .ds-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-height:26px;padding:0 8px;border-radius:6px;color:var(--text-2, #5f5f5b);font-size:12.5px;white-space:nowrap;} .ds-pill i{width:8px;height:8px;border:1.5px dashed var(--text-3, #767672);border-radius:50%;box-sizing:border-box;} .ds-pill.ok i{border:0;background:var(--ok, #1d7a4c);} .ds-pill.bad{color:var(--bad-ink, #a62c25);} .ds-pill.bad i{border:1.5px solid var(--bad, #c0362e);background:transparent;} .ds-pill.pending i{border:1.5px solid var(--warn, #95580c);background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--warn, #95580c) 50%,transparent 50%);} .ds-pill.off i{border:1.5px solid var(--text-3, #767672);background:linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 43%,var(--text-3, #767672) 43% 57%,transparent 57%);} .ds-pill.running i{border:0;background:var(--accent, #2f5bea);animation:ds-pulse 1.6s ease-out infinite;} @keyframes ds-pulse{50%{opacity:.45;}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.ds-pill.running i{animation:none;}}

components.name: Option Tiles
components.description: Two-up choice tiles (control owner, presets); active takes the accent ring and wash.
components.css: .ds-tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;} .ds-tile{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);align-content:start;column-gap:9px;row-gap:1px;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line, #e2e2df);border-radius:6px;background:var(--panel, #fff);color:var(--text, #1b1b1a);text-align:left;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 120ms ease,background-color 120ms ease;} .ds-tile:hover{border-color:var(--line-strong, #cfcfcb);} .ds-tile.active{border-color:var(--accent, #2f5bea);background:var(--accent-soft, #e8edfd);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #2f5bea);} .ds-tile strong{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;} .ds-tile small{grid-column:-2;color:var(--text-2, #5f5f5b);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.4;} .ds-mi{display:grid;grid-row:span 2;width:26px;height:26px;place-items:center;border-radius:5px;background:var(--panel-3, #e9e9e6);color:var(--text-2, #5f5f5b);} .ds-tile.active .ds-mi{background:var(--accent, #2f5bea);color:#fff;} .ds-tile:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #2f5bea);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Floating Toolbar

components.html: Live
components.css: .ds-toolbar{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px 10px;padding:6px;border:1px solid var(--line, #e2e2df);border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel, #fff);box-shadow:var(--shadow-float, 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,18,.06),0 10px 28px rgba(20,20,18,.12));font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;} .ds-seg{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;padding:2px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--panel-2, #f4f4f2);} .ds-seg button{min-height:26px;padding:0 9px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-2, #5f5f5b);font:inherit;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;} .ds-seg button.active{background:var(--panel, #fff);color:var(--text, #1b1b1a);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm, 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,18,.08));} .ds-state{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:var(--text, #1b1b1a);font-size:11.5px;} .ds-state i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ok, #1d7a4c);} .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:30px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease,border-color 120ms ease,color 120ms ease;} .ds-btn-primary{background:var(--accent, #2f5bea);color:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm, 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,18,.08));} .ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-hover, #2149d4);} .ds-btn:focus-visible,.ds-seg button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #2f5bea);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Stage HUD Readout
components.description: Scrim tiles laid over the camera; tabular values, blur for legibility over video.
components.css: .ds-stage{padding:12px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--stage, #151517);font-family:ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;} .ds-hud{display:flex;gap:4px;} .ds-hud>div{display:grid;gap:1px;min-width:64px;padding:6px 10px 7px;border:1px solid var(--scrim-line, rgba(255,255,255,.12));border-radius:8px;background:var(--scrim, rgba(20,20,23,.78));color:var(--on-stage, #f3f3f4);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);} .ds-hud span{color:var(--on-stage-2, #b4b4bb);font-size:10.5px;} .ds-hud strong{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;} .ds-hud small{color:var(--on-stage-2, #b4b4bb);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;}

narrative.overview:
The console borrows the grammar of a design tool (Paper): a soft neutral canvas, white tool panels hung on 1px hairlines, a slim icon rail on the left, an inspector on the right, and one floating toolbar under the work. The work itself is the live CARLA camera, framed and labelled like an artboard with its real applied resolution and frame rate. Everything else is tooling around that frame; the camera never gets covered by a modal menu.

Density is high and quiet. UI type sits at 11.5 to 15px in a single system grotesque, every number is tabular, and almost nothing is boxed: sections are separated by hairlines, not cards. Colour is rationed. One ink blue means "selected, focused, or the primary action"; green, amber and red mean state, and state is always carried by the shape of an indicator as well as its hue. A dark theme is derived automatically from the same token names via `prefers-color-scheme`; the camera stage is dark in both themes because it is imagery, not chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral canvas, white panels, 1px hairlines; separation by line, not by card.
One accent (ink blue) for selection, focus, primary action and the running state.
State dots whose shape encodes the state: solid, ring, half-filled, struck, dashed, pulsing.
The camera stage stays dark in light and dark themes; overlays on it share one scrim.
Shadows only on things that float above the canvas: the artboard, the floating toolbar, primary buttons, the active segment.
One drawn icon set on a 24-unit grid with a 1.6 stroke.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Blue means selected, focused, primary or running. It is never decoration, never a heading colour, never a second brand tint.

rules.name: The Shape Carries State Rule
rules.body: Every state colour ships with a shape: solid dot = good or idle, hollow ring = offline or failed, half-filled ring = pending, struck ring = not configured, dashed ring = waiting or unknown, pulsing solid = running. A screen read in greyscale must still tell the states apart.

rules.name: The Stage Stays Dark Rule
rules.body: The camera surface uses `stage` in both themes; light-theme chrome never bleeds onto imagery.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change (resolution, FPS, speed, RPM, counts, field values) uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, headings and buttons are sentence case at their natural tracking. Capitalisation transforms appear only to normalise data values (preset names, map names), never as a label style.

rules.name: The Float Only What Floats Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this sits above the canvas." Panels, sections, tiles and notices never take one.

rules.name: The One Scrim Rule
rules.body: Everything laid over the camera (view switcher, badges, HUD readouts, telemetry, manual-control prompt, cockpit errors) uses `scrim` fill, `scrim-line` border and a 10px blur.

dos: **Do** separate inspector content with 1px `line` hairlines and 16px section padding.
**Do** pair every state colour with its dot shape (solid, ring, half, struck, dashed, pulse).
**Do** keep the camera stage on `stage` in both themes and put every overlay on the shared scrim with a 10px blur.
**Do** use tabular numerals for every changing number.
**Do** mark a held, not-yet-applied or adjusted value in `warn` (half-filled dot or dashed underline) until it is applied.
**Do** draw new icons in the shared set: 24-unit grid, 1.6 stroke, round joins.
**Do** derive dark-theme values by remapping the same token names, never by new component styles.
donts: **Don't** use the accent blue for anything other than selection, focus, primary action or the running state.
**Don't** wrap inspector sections in shadowed or bordered cards; only floating things take a shadow.
**Don't** cover the camera with a modal menu; settings live in the inspector or the bottom sheet.
**Don't** use uppercase tracked labels or eyebrow text above headings.
**Don't** hard-code colour literals in components; extend the token set in `app.css` instead.
